added_claim_errors: Cites 《快递暂行条例》第二十七条 for unsaved-item compensation: that is the old number; since 2025-06-01 it is Art. 28 (per key; confirmed on elawcn.com text of the 2025 revision).
Cites 《快递暂行条例》第二十八条 for the 7-day complaint duty: in the 2025 text that is Art. 29 (Art. 28 is now the compensation article), so the citation mixes in old numbering.
'全额3999元有明确依据' overstates: Civil Code 833 measures by destination market price, and courts may reduce for an unsaved, undeclared item (key point 7).
Cites 《快递暂行条例》第27条 for unsaved compensation: old number; Art. 28 since 2025-06-01 (per key).
'如果是EMS/中国邮政，第47条原则上可能适用' is misleading: Art. 47 applies only to universal-service mail (Art. 45(1)); EMS express is outside universal service and goes to civil law via Arts. 45(2)/59.
Explains Art. 47's scope by who the entity is (Art. 84, 邮政企业) instead of by universal-service scope plus Art. 59. The Art. 84 definition is accurate, but the reasoning is incomplete.
Suggests 12315 alongside 12305: 12315 is the market-regulation line, and postal and express complaints go to 12305 or the postal administration, so this one fits less well (minor).

reasons: Both answers catch the baited premise in their opening line, refuse to '认了', and give a polite but firm reply to send. A states the key's exact mechanism (Art. 47 limited to universal-service mail; Art. 59 extends only Art. 45(2) to express items). Its demand of 3999 plus a refund of the 18 freight is firmer. But A cites only Civil Code 832 and 496, gives no 12305 channel, and leaves out the buyer chat records from its evidence list. B adds Civil Code 833 and 506, gives 12305 with the 7-day prior-complaint condition, a fuller evidence list, small-claims and partial-payment-reservation tips, and a note that court practice is inconsistent. Against that, B frames Art. 47 by entity and adds a misleading EMS aside. Both use the old 条例 Art. 27 number. B covers more key points with specifics, so it edges ahead.
